policy: Exact patches and container digests are frozen in machine files at adoption; this baseline selects release lines and verified reference patches. Phase 2.2 note: this file is an unsealed machine-authority convenience registry (no stack/*.sha256 seal covers it) subordinate to stack/STACK.md; extending it with previously-omitted exact-pin entries that already match already-enforced package.json/lockfile state is evidence completion, not a normative stack amendment. See governance/CONTROL_PLANE_REPORT.md Phase 2.2 for the classification reasoning.

schema_version_history.1: 2026-08-07 — initial baseline (runtime.node, compiler.*, database.*, frontend.*, identity.*, libraries.*, container_policy). Package manager (pnpm) and task orchestrator (Turborepo) versions were not represented anywhere in this file, even though SEL-04/SCC-04 name both by exact-pin requirement; package.json's packageManager field and exact turbo devDependency were the only pins.
schema_version_history.2: 2026-08-08 (Phase 2.2) — added packages.pnpm and packages.turborepo reference patches (evidence completion: these were already exactly pinned and CI/frozen-lockfile-enforced in package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml; this file simply now names the reference value they must equal). Added compiler.typescript_compat.compiler_engine to record, as a distinct fact from the package-level pin, that the wrapper package's own dependency on its real compiler engine ("@typescript/old") is declared as an upstream semver range ("npm:typescript@^6"), independently reproduced to resolve to typescript@6.0.3 from a clean install of the exact declared package_alias, and frozen at that value by pnpm-lock.yaml for this repository. No numeric value in schema_version 1 was changed; only omissions were filled in and one previously-implicit fact was made explicit.

pnpm.note: Added in Phase 2.2 as evidence completion. SEL-04's binding constraint is 'exact packageManager field, frozen lockfile' — both were already true and CI/machine-enforced before this entry existed; this entry gives scripts/verify-toolchain-baseline.ts an explicit declared reference_patch to check the installed pnpm binary against, instead of deriving 'expected' from whatever is currently installed.

turborepo.package_alias: turbo -> exact devDependency "2.10.8" (no range, no wrapper indirection)
turborepo.note: Added in Phase 2.2 as evidence completion. Unlike the TypeScript compatibility package, turbo has no transitive engine-resolution indirection: `turbo --version`, the package.json devDependency, and the pnpm-lock.yaml resolution are all exactly 2.10.8 with no semver range anywhere in the chain.

compiler_engine.fact: The @typescript/typescript6@6.0.2 wrapper package's own package.json declares "dependencies": { "@typescript/old": "npm:typescript@^6" } — a semver RANGE for its real compiler engine, not an exact pin, and not something this repository's package.json/devDependencies controls.
compiler_engine.resolution_evidence: pnpm-lock.yaml snapshot: "'@typescript/typescript6@6.0.2': dependencies: '@typescript/old': typescript@6.0.3"; confirmed at runtime via node_modules/.pnpm/@typescript+typescript6@6.0.2/node_modules/@typescript/old/package.json (version 6.0.3) and `tsc6 --version` -> "Version 6.0.3".
compiler_engine.independently_reproduced: Yes — a from-scratch `pnpm install` of only "typescript": "npm:@typescript/typescript6@6.0.2" in a disposable directory outside this repository, with no other dependencies present, resolved @typescript/old to typescript@6.0.3 as well. This rules out local lockfile drift/contamination: the range resolution is an intrinsic, reproducible property of the published @typescript/typescript6@6.0.2 package, not an artifact of this repository's dependency graph.
compiler_engine.classification: Upstream package design combined with a latent schema gap in this file: reference_patch above pins the wrapper PACKAGE version exactly (and that pin holds), but this file previously had no field capturing that the wrapper's real compiler ENGINE version is a separate fact the wrapper does not exactly pin itself. Not local lockfile drift; not a pnpm resolution violation; the frozen pnpm-lock.yaml makes the engine version deterministic and reproducible for this repository's tree, but that value (6.0.3) diverges from this file's package-level reference_patch (6.0.2) when the two are compared as if they were one fact.
compiler_engine.scc04_effect: This is why SCC-04 in governance/control-implementation.json is 'partial', not 'implemented': the package-level pin is exact and verified (scripts/verify-toolchain-baseline.ts reports [OK] for it), but 'compilers ... are exact' at the engine-execution level is only true through the frozen lockfile's determinism, not through this baseline's own reference_patch field, which does not describe the engine. No STACK.md amendment is required for this — see governance/CONTROL_PLANE_REPORT.md Phase 2.2 for why this is implementation/evidence remediation, not a normative contradiction.

libraries.hono: exact patch from lockfile; Node adapter only
libraries.playwright: exact patch and browser bundle from lockfile/install manifest

container_policy: All release images are digest-pinned in deployment manifests; tags alone are insufficient.
